title: How does activity logging work?
intent: This article explains how EUSurvey tracks and logs user activities on surveys.
short_answer: EUSurvey can log user activities performed on surveys, such as edits, publications, deletions, and contribution management. Activity logging must be enabled per survey. Once enabled, the Activity page shows a chronological log of all actions with user, timestamp, and details.
prerequisites: Activity logging must be enabled for the survey
procedure: Enable activity logging in survey settings (if not already enabled).
Navigate to the Activity page from the survey management menu.
View the chronological log of activities.
Use filters to narrow the activity view.
Export activities to a file if needed.
important_conditions: Activity logging must be explicitly enabled per survey.
The system tracks: object (what was affected), event (what happened), property (what changed), old value, new value.
Activities can be exported via the Exports page.
The activity log includes user identification and timestamps.
Administrators can configure which activity types are logged system-wide.
Activity logging can be enabled/disabled from the administration panel.
troubleshooting: No activities showing: Activity logging may not be enabled for this survey. Enable it in survey settings.
